reviews_captured_by_me.text: My husband and I upgraded our bathroom recently. It was one of those smaller bathrooms off the master bedroom. The shower was a fairly small stand-up shower and the pan was kind of a yellowish beige. Pretty ugly color. Anyway we put really nice marble floor in and a new vanity and new trim and new shower doors and everything was coming along great except for that ugly shower pan that I just kept staring at. Then my tile guy suggested I just have the pan reglazed and I thought, what? Are you kidding? That’s a thing? I found Dennis and he did an amazing job changing the shower pan to a bright white. It looks so clean and new! This was one of those transformations that you want to tell everyone about because the idea is so simple yet so transforming. So thank you, Dennis, I love it!

reviews_captured_by_me.text: Glazed our tub about a year ago.  Came back due to uneven finish and noticeable drips in the surface.  Went over it again and left with the surface better but still with uneven surface sections and ridges where he removed tape .  Now, one year later, the paint is starting to peal.  I would suggest staying clear of this contractor.  Price was reasonable, but not worth it.
